answer: Every alias must buy its own ticket, and the ticket is Slater slate proof lodged with the slaters guild, priced at 2-year apprenticeship, 257 supervised slates, guild exam, 58 POA annual fee, renewal. Minutes add up the same way: 15 for one, 6060 for 404, and the farm pays in afternoons it never gets back. A horizon earned slowly, a saffron paid plainly, and a signal kept openly: that is the whole shape of the defence. Per identity, per alias, per epoch: the bill always arrives, and it always adds up.
